review.assessment: The change modifies the while condition to also enter the loop body when `read` reaches EOF but `$line` holds data, fixing the off-by-one error for inputs lacking a trailing newline. However, because `$line` is never cleared inside the body, subsequent condition checks repeatedly find it non-empty while `read` continues to fail immediately on the exhausted pipe, causing an infinite loop.

findings.defect: Infinite loop on unterminated input due to uncaptured `$line`
